L.run.pts.length : 0, km: L.run ? +(L.run.len / 1000).toFixed(2) : 0, erster_m: L.run ? Math.round(Math.hypot(L.run.pts[0][0] - L.run.x0, L.run.pts[0][1] - L.run.z0)) : -1 }); })()

(() => { const G = window.G, W = G.LAUF.weg, [x, z] = G.LAUF.run.pts[0]; G.player.pos.set(x + 25, G.TH(x + 25, z + 25), z + 25); G.camYaw.v = Math.atan2(x - G.player.pos.x, z - G.player.pos.z); return JSON.stringify({ strahl: W.beam.visible, hud: W.hud.textContent, mm: W.drawn.mm }); })()
(() => { const G = window.G, W = G.LAUF.weg, m0 = W.drawn.map; G.X.openMenu(); G.X.menuTab('karte'); return JSON.stringify({ vorher: m0, nachher: W.drawn.map }); })()

(async () => { const G = window.G, L = G.LAUF, f0 = G.PROGRESS.P.fit; while (L.run) { const [x, z] = L.run.pts[L.run.i]; G.player.pos.set(x, G.TH(x, z), z); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 400)); } return JSON.stringify({ vorher: f0, nachher: G.PROGRESS.P.fit }); })()
